agentInstructions.label: User instructions
agentInstructions.hint: Describe long-term preferences and habits in plain language. Apart from hard limits such as safety, permissions, approvals, real capabilities and explicit current requests, user instructions take priority over product defaults and model descriptions.
agentInstructions.placeholder:
For example:
Prefer PPIO for image generation; favor quality when compatible.
Keep answers short; run automated checks after changing code.
agentInstructions.privacy: Only content you enter or explicitly ask the assistant to change is saved here. Keys, tokens, authorization headers and passwords are redacted before reaching the model; everything else is sent as is. The assistant never writes conversations, inferences, logs or files here on its own.
